questions.question: What is a 'whole' pizza before you cut it?
questions.explanation: Before you cut it, a pizza is one whole, complete item!

questions.question: How many equal pieces do you get if you cut a pizza into 'halves'?
questions.explanation: You get two equal pieces when you cut something in half.

questions.question: If you have four equal pieces of pizza, what is each piece called?
questions.explanation: Each of four equal pieces is called a quarter.
